description: Image Description: The image displays a highly stylized and futuristic keyboard with a sleek, ergonomic design. The keyboard is predominantly black with a glossy finish and features a curved, contoured shape that suggests an emphasis on user comfort. At the top center of the keyboard, there is a small built-in screen displaying the text "WELCOME TO SECOND LIFE" in white capital letters, with navigation options below it labeled "BACK," "^," and "ENTER." This screen is framed by a slightly raised bezel
